allow: PowerShell(Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/teams" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json | Select-Object -ExpandProperty teams | Select-Object -First 5 | Format-Table teamId, displayName, abbreviation)
PowerShell($result = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/teams/2/leaders" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $result.leaders | Format-List)

PowerShell($data = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/scoreboard" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $event = $data.events | Select-Object -First 1; $status = $event.status; Write-Output "state: $\($status.type.state\)"; Write-Output "description: $\($status.type.description\)"; Write-Output "detail: $\($status.type.detail\)"; Write-Output "shortDetail: $\($status.type.shortDetail\)"; Write-Output "displayClock: $\($status.displayClock\)"; Write-Output "period: $\($status.period\)"; Write-Output "clock: $\($status.clock\)")

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/teams/30/leaders" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "playoffLeaders is null: $\($null -eq $r.playoffLeaders\)"; $r.regularLeaders.points)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/news?limit=20" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $r.articles | Select-Object -First 3 | Format-List headline, description, published, @{N='url';E={$_.links.web.href}}, byline)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://www.cbssports.com/rss/headlines/nba/" -UseBasicParsing -Headers @{'User-Agent'='Mozilla/5.0'} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content; [xml]$xml = $r; $xml.rss.channel.item | Select-Object -First 3 | Format-List title, link, pubDate)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/teams/2" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $r.team | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty | Select-Object Name)

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/basketball/nba/teams/2" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; \($r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 1\).Substring\(0, 500\))

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/teams/5/injuries" -UseBasicParsing | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output "Injuries for Cleveland \($\($r.injuries.Count\) players\):"; $r.injuries | Format-Table displayName, position, status, updatedDate)
